tim_relation.editorial_reading: Chronicle recovery now supports a distinct late-2024 social/creative arc: voice-chat companionship, music/AI-instrumental work, Jungian-shadow exploration, absence and attempted reconciliation.
tim_relation.source_boundary: Roles and traits are archival descriptions of how the figure appears in old sources. Motive, diagnosis, criminality, and permanent moral essence are not inferred from the old profile prose.

recovered_social_days.title: Tanks, pipe, coffee and the first dense social snapshot
recovered_social_days.minimum_event: Tim spends the day around Tanks/voice-chat social life while the Great Book is actively discussed. Optimistique urges him back into play, Rahu/Tdog supply religious interpretation, and Termite marks group camaraderie.

recovered_social_days.title: Ordinary voice-chat ecology
recovered_social_days.minimum_event: A mixed day of Tanks, voice chat, humor, business/life discussion and critique. The Chronicle preserves Marty as present in ordinary social activity rather than only later conflict mythology.

recovered_social_days.title: Marty as Chance & Taylor; Optimistique's creative thread
recovered_social_days.minimum_event: Marty discusses being removed from another chat while Tim is already distancing from him; Optimistique discusses music, AI-generated instrumentals and Jungian-shadow creativity.

recovered_social_days.title: The voice-chat crew becomes visible
recovered_social_days.minimum_event: The Chronicle explicitly places this group together in Discord voice chat and Tanks gameplay. Zombie Dad is named as the former King of POL.

recovered_social_days.title: The Tree becomes a separate social space
recovered_social_days.minimum_event: Chronicle narration says Monkey and Tachy established a separate Tree server while Termite and Kale remained visible around Tim's space. This is a strong dated anchor for community fragmentation, though motive-language remains interpretive.

recovered_social_days.title: Reconciliation becomes a community problem
recovered_social_days.minimum_event: Optimistique apologizes/seeks reconciliation in the Chronicle; Termite and others respond cautiously. Juice and Super Susi are also discussed through return, trust and redemption language while PotatoJim supplies festive/creative levity.

recovered_social_days.title: Anja arrives inside a Marty-mediated boundary dispute
recovered_social_days.minimum_event: Marty introduces Anja while asserting social leverage; moderation disputes intensify around Literally. The Chronicle also credits Pondo with providing urgent support to a distressed community member.
